m: लैखाभ्रेय m. patr. fr. लेखाभ्र or metron. fr. लेखा-भ्रू, g. शुभ्रादि.
लैख m. patr. fr. लेख, g. शिवादि

a: लैंगं — N. of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.
लैंगिक — a. (की f.) [लिंग-ठण्] 1 Depending on or relating to a sign or mark. --2 Inferred (अनुमित). --कः A maker of images, statuary.

s: strI, liNginI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ liNga sambanDini, tri ॥
m: लैङ्गी f. a species of plant, L.

s: klI, (liNgamaDikftya kfto granTa iti । liNgasyedamiti vA । liNga + aR .) liNgapurARam । yaTA, -- “mAtsyaM kOrmmyaMtaTAlENgaM SEvaM skAndantaTEva ca ॥” ityAdi pAdmottaraKaRqe 34 aDyAyaH ॥ (asya vivaraRAdikaM purARaSabde drazwavyam ॥)
v: na॰ liNgamaDikftya kfto granTaH aR । azwAdaSasu mahApurARezu ekAdaSe 1 mahApurARe । liNgaM tadAkAraH astyasyAH Palezu aR NIp । 2 liNginIvfkze strI rAjani॰ tasyedamaRa । 2 liNgasambadDe tri॰ striyAM NIp ।
m: लैङ्ग mf(ई)n. (fr. लिङ्ग) relating to grammatical gender, Pat.
लैङ्ग n. N. of a Purāṇa and an Upapurāṇa.
लैङ्ग—धूम m. an ignorant priest (who does not know the god, metre &c. of Vedic hymns), L.

v: tri॰ liNgenAnumApakacihnAdinA ApAditastata Agato vA WaRa । liNgAdiBiH 1 kalpite 2 anumite sADye liNgopahitalENgikaBAnamityAcAryyAH । arTaprakASasAmarTyaliNgena kalpite 3 mantraHdInAM tattatkarmmAdi viniyoge ca ।
m: लैङ्गिक mfn. based upon a characteristic mark or evidence or proof, Sāy.
लैङ्गिक m. a sculptor, Kap., Sch.
लैङ्गोद्भव n. (the tale of) the origin of the Liṅga, Bālar.
लैण् cl. 1. P. लैणति, to go; to send; to embrace, Dhātup. xiii, 15 (w.r. for पैण्).
a: लैण् — {c1c} P. (लैणति) 1 To go, approach. --2 To send. --3 To embrace.

m: लैशिक n. the offence of a monk who taking advantage of an apparent transgression committed by a fellow monk wrongfully accuses him of it, Buddh.
लैगवायन m. a patr. fr. लिगु, g. नडादि.
लैगव्यायनी f. a patr. fr. लैगव्य, g. लोहितादि.
